verse.verse_1: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
verse.verse_2: From the mischief of created things;
verse.verse_3: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
verse.verse_4: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
verse.verse_5: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
